name: app_launcher
description: Launch desktop apps, open files with default apps, and control running app windows via AT-SPI2
author: JARVIS

tools.name: app_launch
tools.description: Launch a desktop application by name (e.g. 'kiwix-desktop', 'freecad', 'obsidian', 'code').

tools.name: app_open_file
tools.description: Open a file with its default application (like double-clicking in Files).

path.description: Path to the file to open

tools.name: app_list_windows
tools.description: List all open application windows visible to AT-SPI2.
